blocks.text: With the first phase of the communications work for {{fact:f:E-2021-001.client}} now in place, I wanted to set out where things stand and what we will need from your side before the customer letter goes out. Replies on this thread will keep the record in one place.

Where things stand, in order: the holding statement and core Q&A are approved and in use; the employee note went out with your sign-off; and every inbound media question is now recorded in the shared log, with the answer given and who gave it. Inquiries have been steady but manageable, and none so far has needed language beyond the approved Q&A. The customer letter is drafted and with your legal team for review.

Before the customer letter can be finalized, we need your confirmation of which remediation milestones the operations team is comfortable stating publicly. It would also help to know which colleague in finance should see the investor language before we circulate it more widely.

Once the letter is approved, Nancy will send you the release-day checklist and the distribution list for a final check. Thank you, too, for turning the employee note around so quickly. If a short call early next week is easier than replying here, I am glad to set one up.
